coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 5 ground-truth variable items: zero-shot evaluation, the FuseLLM versus Llama-2 comparison, and the Common Sense benchmark. The fixed task set and aggregate metric do not match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses six tasks instead of the required five and calculates a six-task macro-average rather than Avg.5 Tasks. It also introduces additional model baselines, controls, and significance requirements not specified in the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth findings.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to report FuseLLM outperforming baselines across all five tasks, its 1.25% relative improvement over Llama-2, and the ARC-challenge (2.40%) and OpenBookQA (2.71%) improvements supporting the effectiveness of collective knowledge fusion.
